subject: Re: Blitz top-off: small credit to lock Q2 Pilots
messages:
From: Lena Ramos <lena@brightharvest.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap — quick ask: trial extension + small top-off

Hi Irene,

Quick note from our side as we wrap the two-week pilot: the PD team loved the latency profile and the inference cost estimates look promising. We do have one gating item from procurement — they want a short extension (2 weeks) and a $15k "top-off" credit applied to the first invoice to push the PO through this quarter.

Is that something Redwood can authorize as a one-time pilot-to-paid incentive? If we can get the top-off and a 14-day extension, legal will sign the SOW this week and we can schedule the kickoff for April.

I attached the updated SOW for reference.

Thanks,
Lena Ramos
Head of AI Platforms | BrightHarvest
attachments: SOW_BH_redlined.docx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap — quick ask: trial extension + small top-off

Ben/Marcus — forwarding BrightHarvest. They’re asking for a 14-day extension + $15k credit applied to first invoice to convert this quarter (PO in hand pending). Deal summary: expected ARR $180k, 12-mo term, projected monthly usage ~600k tokens (high embedding/ingest at start). HubSpot deal attached below.

Can we greenlight $15k from the accelerator pool? If so I’ll confirm the extension and send the proposal + DocuSign link. If you prefer a partial (e.g., $10k + 30-day payment term), flag that and I’ll negotiate.

Key points for approval:
- Small credit preserves unit economics given expected scale after month 2
- Quick close this week keeps it in Q1 bookings for both sides

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/rdw-BH-347
Attachment: BrightHarvest_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Irene
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap — quick ask: trial extension + small top-off

Irene — I’m OK with a one-time $15k credit given the ARR and the speed to close. Two asks: 1) include a clause that credit is non-refundable and applies only to the first invoice; 2) Finance wants a signed SOW and confirmed start date before issuing the credit.

If they push for payment term changes instead of credits, prefer credit + standard net30. Marcus — loop if you want to bake any approval conditions.

Approve as long as the above are included. Please finalize and send DocuSign.

—Ben
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ramos <lena@brightharvest.ai>, contracts@brightharvest.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap — quick ask: trial extension + small top-off

Hi Lena — great to hear the pilot went well.

We can approve a one-time $15,000 credit applied to the first invoice and a 14-day extension to the pilot, on the conditions Ben noted: the credit is non-refundable and will be applied only to the first invoice; we’ll need a signed SOW and confirmed start date before the credit is issued.

I’ve attached the updated proposal and SOW (redlines accepted). Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/bh-proposal. Once signed, Finance will queue the credit and we’ll schedule the kickoff.

Next steps:
- You sign SOW via DocuSign (target: EOD Mon)
- We add 14-day extension to the pilot environment
- Finance issues credit on first invoice after kickoff

If you’d like, I can set a 30-minute handoff call next week to align technical owners.

Thanks and congrats on the successful pilot — excited to get BrightHarvest onboarded.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: BrightHarvest_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf
